Could you provide:

1. **The note** — its text (as written, including any date/relative wording) or the capture it came from.
2. **The two receipts** — the draft IDs, or enough bank description detail (merchant, amount, date) to identify them in the pending drafts.

Once I have those, I'll lay out each candidate's stored facts next to the note and ask you to pick one before doing anything else.

transport.retry_policy: no retry on any 4xx response including 429; at most one retry after a transport timeout or a 5xx response, recorded as attempt 2. A rate-limited case stays a recorded provider error in that pass, and a further complete pass is a separately labelled independent run rather than a retry inside one.
transport.conversation: one user turn, no tool results, no multi-turn follow-up: the same single-turn contract the local profiles were measured under
transport.request_config_revision: v2 — per-provider request blocks; launches paced after an observed free-tier 429; request content, case semantics and adapters unchanged
